verdict.rationale: The release notes mention composing prompts as 'response drafts' and asking the session agent to open a draft PR from the GitHub tab or diff view. Together these imply you can send further instructions to an existing session, but no doc explicitly describes steering an active, running agent mid-task without restarting it. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of sending follow-up messages to a running session, confirmation that the session continues without restart, interrupt or steer semantics, and any hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can send follow-up instructions to an active agent session to steer its work without restarting

citations.quote: Live multiplayer response drafts — Write prompts together with shared text, named cursors, presence, read-only viewing, and draft recovery.
Ask the session agent to open a draft pull request from the GitHub tab or diff view.
You will control the task from app.humanlayer.com on a machine or phone.
